caption:
If Andromeda tanked your ads in 2024, that was the small update.

Meta just shipped the big one. It now scores every eligible ad (over a billion a second) and reads the order of ads each person already engaged with.

What that means for you:
→ 50 versions of one idea = 1 shot
→ 5 genuinely different ideas = 5 shots
→ Still test hooks and lines, but to find the message, not to scale

Test variations to find each winner. Then put your most different winners together and let Meta match them to the right people.

💬 Want to fix the lack of leads in your business? Comment "GROWTH".
